Shelgon

Dragon

Hoenn · Generation 3

Shelgon is a Dragon-type Endurance Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 110.5 kg. It evolves from Bagon and into Salamence. Its highest base stat is Defense (100), with a base stat total of 420.
